q23 prints the first answer point inline on the number line (' The Northern Mountains.') then 3 bullets -> included as solution_step 1 (addendum §5.1); 4 steps total

q25 is a 2-column comparison TABLE (Western Ghats vs Eastern Ghats, 1 header row + 4 data rows) -> represented as solution_steps, one step per printed row, cells joined ' | ' (gate log v6 §1); header row is step 1; answer.kind stays text, no space-padded run in value
q27 first bullet wraps across two printed lines ('...Indian ocean in the' / 'south.') -> merged into one solution_step (continuation, not a new point); 4 steps
q28 fourth bullet ('These hills have narrow strips... Dunes') is printed at the top of pdf 92 (page spill) -> 4 steps
map questions q29, q30 (section IV) are NOT built here — added in a separate map-crop-first pass (relay 10 §3): answer-map crops committed as their own commit before the features list

key-lines self-count (relay 10): q22 printed 6 = stored 6; q23 inline 1 + bullets 3 = 4 = stored 4; q24 4=4; q25 table header+4 rows = 5 printed rows = stored 5 steps; q26 7=7; q27 printed 5 lines, first bullet wraps = 4 logical = stored 4; q28 4 (last on pdf 92) = 4; vsa 6-21 single-value; mcq 1-5 option keys; no drops

DIFFICULTY-TABLE-VS-TAGS defect (register): printed distribution table says Easy 9 / Average 16 / Difficult 5 / Total 30, but per-question tags are Easy 9 / Average 15 / Difficult 6 — table has 1 extra Average and 1 fewer Difficult; tags win (v2 §6)
